_read_me: Tor Browser explainer script — Hinglish. One beat per section for the 9:16 reel.

sections.label: HOOK
sections.say: Bhai, kabhi socha hai Tor Browser tumhari identity hide kaise karta hai? Tum website open karte ho, lekin tumhari request seedha website tak nahi jaati!
sections.on_screen: TOR BROWSER IDENTITY HIDE KAISE KARTA HAI?
sections.caption: Bhai, kabhi socha hai Tor Browser tumhari identity hide kaise karta hai?

sections.label: ROUTE SELECTION
sections.say: Instead, Tor apne network se teen computers select karta hai — Guard Node, Middle Node aur Exit Node. Aur in teeno se milkar banta hai tumhara secret route!
sections.caption: Tor apne network se teen computers select karta hai.

sections.label: ENCRYPTION
sections.say: Ab tumhari request encrypt hoti hai teen layers mein, bilkul ek ke andar ek rakhe teen envelopes ki tarah! Har computer sirf apni encryption layer remove karta hai aur request aage bhej deta hai.
sections.caption: Request encrypt hoti hai teen layers mein.

sections.label: THREE NODES
sections.say: Guard ko tumhara real IP pata hota hai, lekin destination nahi. Middle ko sirf apne previous aur next computer ka pata hota hai. Aur Exit ko website ka address pata hota hai, lekin tumhara real IP nahi!
sections.caption: Guard ko real IP pata hai, lekin destination nahi.

sections.label: WEBSITE CONNECTION
sections.say: Finally, Exit Node website se connect karta hai. Isliye website ko tumhara real IP nahi, Exit Node ka IP address dikhta hai. Aur response bhi isi route se wapas aata hai!
sections.caption: Website ko Exit Node ka IP dikhta hai.

sections.label: CTA PART 1
sections.say: Bas bhai! Isi technique ko kehte hain Onion Routing!
sections.caption: Isi technique ko kehte hain Onion Routing!

sections.label: CTA PART 2
sections.say: Aise hi interesting tech aur cybersecurity videos ke liye follow kar lena, video ko like karna aur apne tech wale dost ke saath share bhi kar dena!
sections.caption: Follow kar lena, video ko like karna aur share bhi kar dena!

sections.label: OUTRO
sections.say: Milte hain next video mein. Tab tak apna IP sambhal ke rakhna!
sections.caption: Milte hain next video mein. Tab tak apna IP sambhal ke rakhna!
